next_step: Finalize capacity sizing doc and submit MSA to legal
notes: Background: mid-market product analytics SaaS. Building an in-app AI assistant for product managers and support triage. Started Hosted API trial to validate UX and cost assumptions.
Hosted trial (3 weeks): onboarding via simple SDK, ran ~70k tokens/day average during trial week, peaked at 280k tokens/day during customer demo week.
Observed traffic characteristics during trial: avg QPS ~7, observed short bursts to 28 QPS; typical session: prompt ~120 tokens, completion ~420 tokens (avg session ~540 tokens).
Token mix (trial): 30% <64 tokens, 50% 64-512 tokens, 20% >512 tokens. Long tail of >1024 tokens for doc-summarization flows (slow path).
Performance notes: Hosted 95th-pctl response latency climbed to ~430ms on heavy long-request windows (seq lengths >800). Short prompts have good tail behavior but want stricter SLOs.
Business ask: move to Dedicated for predictable cost and SLOs; must demonstrate sizing and QPS headroom for launch (calendar Q1 playbook).

Traffic forecast provided by customer (internal PM): steady QPS target 15, expected daily peak 60 QPS (30-min peak window), concurrency target 40. Monthly token forecast ~400M with 3% month-over-month growth assumptions.
Dedicated sizing asks from PO: support steady 15 QPS with 3x headroom, ability to burst to hosted for weekend campaign spikes, autoscale policy required (min capacity + burst backstop).

Initial Redwood recommendation (sales/SE): 4x A100-80GB equiv pool or 6x A10-class nodes for cost/perf balance; enable KV/prefix caching for product assistant to reduce per-token cost; enable automatic routing fallback to hosted during rare overages.
Cost sensitivity: procurement targeting committed spend $10k-$25k/mo first year. Wants committed price with clear overage rates. Open to annual commit if discounted 12-18%.

Security/compliance: SSO/SAML mandatory, SOC2 required, must integrate with customer KMS for key custody, audit logging retention 12 months, data residency preference: us-east for now. Legal flagged additional language on derivative models/data usage.
PO quotes: 'Predictability is the top priority — both latency during demos and monthly bill clarity.' — Head of Product. Also: 'We need a two-week stress test on Dedicated before committing.'
Sales cadence: AE demo 2024-09-25, POC kickoff 2024-10-04, SE sizing workshop 2024-10-18, Hosted trial wrap call 2024-10-21 (fireflies id above).

POC milestones (requested): 1) capacity worksheet validated with real traffic (2 days), 2) Dedicated smoke test (48 hours) with target concurrency, 3) run long-seq summarization job to evaluate KV cache + cold-start behavior.

Known risks / open technical questions: type of quantization supported for customer's model variants, cold-start tail for long sequences, exact cache hit rates in production workload, integration pattern for customer KMS and SSO flows.
Open commercial items: final ARR band, overage pricing, SLA credits and uptime targets, legal: data residency clause and IP language (we have draft MSA in Drive).

Next steps (immediate): SE to deliver detailed capacity worksheet by 2024-11-08, schedule 2-day Dedicated stress POC for week of 2024-11-18, AE to escalate pricing to revenue ops for commit band approval.
Internal note: prioritize meeting with infra team to confirm A100 vs A10 cost sensitivity; prepare fallback plan using Hosted API credits to cover demo spikes.
